idea: On AK's go (1 Nov 2026): GST and NPCI data came; Short 1 of two. Assam: October 2026 domestic GST +47.1%, highest of 33 states and UTs (states under ₹50 crore in Oct 2025 left out), also highest April to October (+38.3%). Fresh angle: in rupees Maharashtra added 6.7 times what Assam added (our calculation). House map look first.
alt_title: Assam's GST Rose 47% in October: Highest of 33 States
description: Assam's domestic GST rose 47.1% in October 2026 over October 2025 (₹1,315 crore to ₹1,934 crore), the highest of 33 states and UTs with a large enough base. Next: Manipur, 40.6%. Provisional figures, GSTN.

April to October 2026: Assam +38.3%, the highest of 36; Uttar Pradesh next at 15.5%.
In rupees, Assam added ₹619 crore; Maharashtra added ₹4,137 crore (our calculation from the printed figures). The table shows how much, not why.
Closing map: October GST growth, every state. Blank: Lakshadweep, Andaman and Nicobar, Mizoram (under ₹50 crore in October 2025).
source: Goods and Services Tax Network (GSTN), 'Gross and Net GST revenue collections for the month of October, 2026', posted 1 Nov 2026, provisional: Table 3 (domestic GST in each state, October 2026 and October 2025; GST on imports not included) and Table 4 (domestic collection April to October, growth on April to October 2025). Growth in rupees is our calculation from the printed figures. States that collected under ₹50 crore in October 2025 are left out of the ranking: Lakshadweep, Andaman and Nicobar, Mizoram.
